title: Marion County Commission, District 4
what_it_does: County commissioners set the county budget and property-tax (millage) rate, adopt land-use and zoning rules, and oversee county services such as roads, parks, libraries, fire/EMS and utilities.
verified_ballot_note: Incumbent Carl Zalak did not seek re-election after 16 years (WCJB, June 4, 2026, https://www.wcjb.com/2026/06/04/marion-county-commission-chairman-carl-zalak-not-seeking-reelection-after-16-years-board/). Four Republicans ran in the Aug. 18 primary (WCJB, Aug. 2, 2026); the Florida Division of Elections candidate list shows Jeff Bairstow as the qualified Republican and Randall Alvord, Wanda Lasher and Sherri Meadows as defeated, with write-in Leonard Michael Racioppi qualified for November (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp).

candidates.name: Jeff Bairstow
candidates.background: Won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary for the open District 4 seat (WCJB, Aug. 2, 2026, https://www.wcjb.com/2026/08/02/4-republicans-vie-open-marion-county-commission-seat/). Qualified for the Nov. 3, 2026 ballot according to the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list (Qualified). Not yet researched.
